subject: Saving plots for export using a counter

messages.author: 77ec13444c2d5ddf
messages.subject: Saving plots for export using a counter
parts:
I am trying to incorporate an export feature into my app that allows users to save reactively updating plots as they make them via an action button and then download them in a batch later. The saved plots should go to a reactiveValues list, which will eventually be submitted to grid.arrange and exported as a .pdf. In the example below, I attempt to name plots for the list using a counter which will eventually be replaced by the system time. I create a string which contains the intended unique plot name, based on the counter. That works fine, and appears to add something to the list. However, when I attempt to investigate the object using browser(), it tells me that the saved plot is NULL. Is there an alternative way to rename a ggplot object or add it to a list? Or is there a more elegant way entirely to save plots for downloading in a batch? 

# Intended sequence of events:
## 1. User makes plot
## 2. User clicks "save button,"
## 3. Plot goes to list of output objects, with name generated by counter 

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

# Example UI

ui <- fluidPage(
  verticalLayout(
    titlePanel("Example"),
    plotOutput("plot1"),
    wellPanel(
      sliderInput("n", "Number of points", 10, 200,
                  value = 50, step = 10),
     
      actionButton("save", "Click here to save your graphics")   # save plot button
      
      # download plots button will go here. 
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  count <- reactiveValues( i = 1)
  
  outputList <- reactiveValues(title = paste("Shiny outputs", Sys.Date()))   # make the list
  
  #make the plot
  
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    
    outputList$plot1 <- ggplot()+
                        geom_point(aes(x = rnorm(input$n), y = rnorm(input$n)))+
                        theme_bw() # store the plot in the output list
    
    outputList$plot1 # print the plot for the ui
  })
  
  observe({input$save # When the user clicks the save button,
    
    isolate ({count$i <- count$i + 1}) # increase the counter by 1 
    
    # paste("outputList$plot", count$i, sep = "") <- outputList$plot1 + ggtitle ("plot")  
    ## tried pasting together the plot name. That didn't work b/c it thinks I'm trying to turn a plot into a string
    ## but I think this SHOULD work, and I don't understand why it doesn't:
    
    plotSlot <- paste("outputList$plot", count$i, sep = "") # make the output naming string
    
    assign(plotSlot, outputList$plot1)  # assign the name to the plot object
     #browser()
     })
  
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
